County Bridge Inspections 2024

1

The bridge was surveyed in October following reports of movement in the eastern abutment, which had been noted by the maintenance crew during a routine inspection that summer.

County Bridge Inspections 2024

2

Measurements taken at six points along the deck showed a maximum deflection of eleven millimetres under the test load, which is within the tolerance the original design allowed.

County Bridge Inspections 2024

3

The abutment itself had shifted by four millimetres since the previous survey, a rate that would take decades to become structurally significant but which should be watched.

County Bridge Inspections 2024

4

A further survey is recommended within eighteen months, and sooner if the crew report any change in the joint above the eastern abutment.
